vc_checking.summary: The three entail witnesses are semantically provable: initialization opens xizi_dll, the first loop step unfolds the nonempty suffix, and the later loop step can extend the processed DLL segment while deriving the unsigned no-wrap bound from finite disjoint owned DLL fields. Both return witnesses are semantically invalid as generated. Their antecedents describe resources rooted at the current logical variable linklist, while their consequents require xizi_dll or sentinel resources rooted at an independent universally quantified linklist_pre. No premise equates these addresses. Choosing linklist_pre=0 and any satisfiable nonzero linklist state makes each antecedent satisfiable and every generated post disjunct false. The loop invariant must restore an internal entry/current-head bridge and symbolic execution must regenerate the VCs before proving.
